Lines that could not be round-tripped exactly by every tokenizer condition were excluded from all splits: {'tgl': 1, 'ind': 0}. A non-invertible line would be mis-decoded if kept, so exclusion is strictly safer; the rate is under 0.5% and identical across conditions.

PROBE CIRCULARITY (measured): the Tagalog voice probe is solved outright by a trivial baseline that reads the <INF:...> token alone -- G15 accuracy 1.000 under MorphAustro-Tok vs 0.000 under matched BPE. It is reported as DIAGNOSTIC, not evidential, and carries no independent weight for H1; H1 rests on MT and NER, which are non-circular. The Indonesian classifier-agreement probe is a corruption-judgment task and is unaffected.

DESIGN REVISION (measured, not preferred): the Indonesian MT and NER arms were cut after the live gate run showed MorphAustro-Tok and matched BPE separate by only 0.18% in tokens/char on Indonesian (vs 7.00% on Tagalog), the mechanism touching 0.258% of tokens. H2 is tested by the classifier-agreement probe alone; its MT and NER claims go unrun. The freed 4.41 GPU-hours fund 5 seeds on Tagalog instead of 3 (t_crit 4.30 -> 2.78).
